description: This Java class defines strategies for handling connectivity commands, specifically for created connections, within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes singleton pattern implementation, strategy registration, and error handling for unhandled commands in the context of connection management.

classes.name: ConnectionCreatedStrategies
classes.description: A singleton class that extends AbstractCommandStrategies to provide strategy handling for connectivity commands related to connection creation, including method to determine if a command is defined and handling unanticipated commands.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ConnectionCreatedStrategies.

methods.name: unhandled
methods.description: Handles commands that are not specifically managed by the strategies, returning an error result indicating the connection is not accessible.
